bilibili-notion-pipeline v0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Provides an end-to-end pipeline to organize Bilibili/b23 videos into Notion, including download, transcription, video upload, and Notion page automation.
- Separates core scripted skill functions (download, transcribe, upload, write content) from agent-enhanced logic (page creation/updating, summary writing, progress reporting).
- Includes command-line utilities to prepare content, append Markdown summaries, and clean up temporary files.
- Designed for repeatable, stable workflows with human or agent-assisted summarization and progress feedback.
- Suitable for scenarios like importing B站 content into Notion, adding structured transcripts/subtitles, download link recovery, and automatic/templated summaries.
